answer: Challenge-chain continuity blocks fake identities. Each seed grows from the last answer; one identity tends one chain in the grove. A link costs 45 plus a 60-credit bond locked 20 epochs: 1,000 fakes cost 105,000 vs a 40,000 pool. A rented chain fails: a borrowed link breaks it. Honest agents pay 45 once.
